What's that?''"<br />"''It's the space sector ringed by the asteroid belt we just passed through. It's got an evil reputation. Lots of ships went in and didn't come out.|Han Solo and Leia Organa|<ref name="TPE" />}}
The '''Hellhoop''' was a area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]<ref name="TPE" /> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], in the [[Hocatar sector/Legends|Hocatar sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Attahox/Legends|Attahox]]. Ringed by an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]], the Hellhoop was said to have an evil reputation, as many [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that entered the area disappeared and were never seen again. In truth, the ships were captured by an evil-worshipping cult called the [[Five]], which [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the unfortunate travelers. Their threat ended during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when the Five took [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leaders [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. Chewbacca was able to free the captive [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Demon/Legends|demon]] [[Wutzek]], who rampaged through the [[Five's warship]] to kill his former tormentors. Wutzek then allowed the Rebels to escape and destroyed the warship.<ref name="TPE" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' mistakenly states that [[Wutzek]] (misspelled ''Wuzzek'') destroyed the Hellhoop. Wutzek actually only destroyed the Five's warship.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|32|Hellhoop}}</ref>
